relationships.subject: Cisplatin
relationships.evidence_quote: Cisplatin reduced the mechanical PWT of mice from the third cisplatin dose (5th day) until 30 days after the first cisplatin administration, indicating the development of mechanical allodynia

relationships.subject: DALBK
relationships.evidence_quote: reduced cisplatin-induced mechanical allodynia from 0.5 up to 2 h after their administration

relationships.subject: Icatibant
relationships.evidence_quote: reduced cisplatin-induced mechanical allodynia from 0.5 up to 2 h after their administration

relationships.subject: Kinin B1 receptor antisense oligonucleotide
relationships.evidence_quote: Antisense oligonucleotides for kinin B1 and B2 receptors attenuated cisplatin-induced mechanical allodynia, with inhibition of 57 ± 8% and 33 ± 7%, respectively

relationships.subject: DABk
relationships.evidence_quote: enhanced cisplatin-induced mechanical nociception 2 h after its administration when compared to the cisplatin plus vehicle group

key_findings: Kinin B1 and B2 receptor antagonists and antisense oligonucleotides attenuated cisplatin-induced mechanical allodynia in male mice but not cold sensitivity.
Sub-nociceptive doses of B1/B2 agonists enhanced cisplatin-induced nociception, reversed by respective antagonists.
